File modified: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Pinzo/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`

**Change 1 — Defaults (line ~186-189)**
Added `showDeliveryDate: true`, `showCountdown: true`, `showDeliveryFee: true` to the `D` defaults object immediately after `showDeliveryDays: true`.

**Change 2 — `formatDeliveryDate` helper (lines 334-344)**
Parses an ISO date string like `"2026-03-28"` into `"Saturday, Mar 28"` using local Date constructor with explicit year/month/day parts (avoids UTC offset issues). Returns `null` on any failure.

**Change 3 — Countdown functions (lines 346-396)**
Three functions placed before `buildSharedCss`:
- `getCountdownData(cutoffTime)` — computes hours/minutes remaining until the cutoff, returns `{ passed, hours, minutes }` or `null`.
- `buildCountdownHtml(cutoffTime, widgetId)` — builds the countdown div with the correct color class (`--green` / `--amber` / `--red` / `--passed`) and anchors it to `widgetId + '-countdown'` for the updater.
- `startCountdownUpdater(widgetId, cutoffTime)` — runs a `setInterval` every 30 seconds to refresh the countdown element in place.

**Change 4 — CSS (lines 437-456 in `buildSharedCss`)**
Added scoped CSS rules for `.zcc-delivery-date`, `.zcc-countdown` (with `--green`, `--amber`, `--red`, `--passed` modifiers), and `.zcc-delivery-fee` (with `--free` and `--paid` modifiers). All rules follow the existing `!important` pattern for theme isolation.

**Change 5 — Success result HTML (lines 656-707)**
Inside the `if (data.allowed)` branch of `wireWidget`:
- Delivery date row inserted after ETA row — guarded by `cfg.showDeliveryDate && data.estimatedDeliveryDate`.
- Countdown row inserted after cutoff time row — guarded by `cfg.showCountdown && data.cutoffTime`.
- Delivery fee badge + free shipping threshold inserted after return policy — guarded by `cfg.showDeliveryFee !== false`, with three sub-cases: free (fee === 0 or null), paid (fee > 0), and the "orders over $X" hint when a threshold exists.

**Change 6 — Countdown updater start (lines 705-707)**
After `res.innerHTML = html` in the success path, calls `startCountdownUpdater(wid, data.cutoffTime)` when `cfg.showCountdown && data.cutoffTime` — so the countdown live-updates without a page reload.

**Scope fix applied:** The initial `var wid = WID` inside the allowed block was removed because `wid` is already the first parameter of `wireWidget` and `WID` is not in scope there. All countdown calls correctly reference the existing `wid` parameter.

`npm run typecheck` — zero errors.
